ctx.x: Sonny Brown; and Sal Mosca, did I say? I think Ron was calling Sal Mosca “The Shadow” or something like that. It didn’t work out at all. Brown came late to the gig and I fired him and he brought me to the union and I didn’t even bother showing up so they fined me and things like that. It was very unpleasant.
You said Ron was reading a newspaper on the date or something, you said earlier?
